content: NuGet lock files: RestorePackagesWithLockFile generates packages.lock.json; presence of file enables it; --locked-mode / RestoreLockedMode fails restore if dependencies changed since lock; lock format version depends on CPM transitive pinning; check in lock files for app/exe projects only (library lock files have no effect on consumers); PrunePackageReference affects lock contents. Source: learn.microsoft.com nuget package-references-in-project-files (2026-02).
